Hi Sophie / Tom —

Thanks again for your time last week. Wed love to run a 45-minute exec-level demo of Redwood Inference focused on predictable latency and routing (Hosted + Dedicated) for Helixs cross-region workflows. We want to make sure the right execs from both sides can attend, so Im proposing a few windows across US / EU / APAC. Note: US DST moved on Mar 12, EU switches on Mar 26, so local offsets will change depending on the date.

Proposed slots (all listed with local equivalents):
- Option A: 2028-03-28 08:00 PT / 11:00 ET / 16:00 GMT+1 (EU) / 23:00 SGT
- Option B: 2028-03-29 06:30 PT / 09:30 ET / 14:30 GMT+1 / 21:30 SGT
- Option C: 2028-03-30 17:00 PT / 20:00 ET / 01:00 GMT+1 (next day) / 08:00 SGT

Can you confirm executive availability (Sophie / CTO / Tom) for any of the above? If none fit, send two alternatives in UTC and well convert and lock with calendar invites that include explicit UTC.

Attaching a short draft agenda and a blank exec availability sheet so we can capture timezones precisely.

Thanks,

- 09:00 PT (US West) / 12:00 ET (US East) / 17:00 CEST (EU after switch) / 00:00 SGT (next day)
